question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who is bad in spellings
solution: The correct answer is **"Cacographer."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Cacographer"** is a person who is bad in spellings. (वह व्यक्ति जिसकी वर्तनी ख़राब हो) • **Example**: *The teacher was frustrated with the **cacographer's**__ spelling errors.* • The word comes from the Greek words **"kakos"** meaning** "bad"** and** "graphos"** meaning **"writing."** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Cartographer: **a person who draws or produces maps. (मानचित्रकार; नक्‍़शानवीस) • **Chauffeur:** a person employed to drive a private car or limousine. (निजी कार या लिमोज़ीन चलाने के लिए नियोजित व्यक्ति) • **Calligrapher:** a person who produces decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush. (एक व्यक्ति जो पेन या ब्रश से सजावटी लिखावट या अक्षरांकन बनाता है) 31:Tc4a, The correct answer is **"Miniature."**
